quizzes.title: Cellular Biology Midterm
quizzes.subject: Biology
quizzes.description: Covers cellular respiration, photosynthesis, organelle structures, and membrane transport fundamentals.

questions.question: What is the primary function of mitochondria in a eukaryotic cell?
options: Cellular respiration and ATP energy production
questions.explanation: Mitochondria are known as the powerhouse of the cell, generating most ATP energy.

questions.question: Which organelle is primarily responsible for protein synthesis?
questions.explanation: Ribosomes translate mRNA sequences into polypeptide chains.

questions.question: What is the process by which plants convert sunlight into biochemical energy?
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis captures light energy to produce glucose.

questions.question: Which process moves water molecules across a semi-permeable membrane?
questions.explanation: Osmosis is the passive diffusion of water across a semi-permeable membrane.

questions.question: Which macromolecule constitutes the primary bilayer of cell membranes?
questions.explanation: Phospholipids form the foundational phospholipid bilayer of biological membranes.

quizzes.title: Calculus Fundamentals 101
quizzes.subject: Mathematics
quizzes.description: Essential limits, derivatives, chain rules, and basic integral calculus applications.

questions.question: What is the derivative of f(x) = x³ - 4x + 7 with respect to x?
questions.explanation: Using the power rule: d/dx(x³) = 3x² and d/dx(-4x) = -4.

questions.question: What is the limit of (sin x) / x as x approaches 0?
What geometric property does the first derivative of a function represent at a point?
questions.explanation: The first derivative represents the instantaneous slope of the tangent line.

quizzes.title: The Industrial Revolution: Key Events
quizzes.subject: History
quizzes.description: Explore the technological breakthroughs, social transformations, and economic shifts of the 18th-19th centuries.

questions.question: In which country did the Industrial Revolution initially begin in the mid-18th century?
questions.explanation: Britain had abundant coal, capital, and trade networks.

questions.question: Which invention by James Watt greatly accelerated industrial mechanization?
questions.explanation: James Watt's steam engine provided reliable mechanized power.

quizzes.title: Data Structures: Trees & Graphs
quizzes.subject: Computer Science
quizzes.description: Master traversal algorithms, binary search trees, graph representations, and algorithmic time complexity.

questions.question: What is the average time complexity for searching in a balanced Binary Search Tree (BST)?
questions.explanation: A balanced BST halves the search space at each level, taking O(log n) time.

questions.question: Which graph traversal algorithm uses a First-In-First-Out (FIFO) queue?
questions.explanation: BFS explores vertices level by level using a FIFO queue.

drafts.title: World History Quiz
drafts.subject: History
drafts.description: Key revolutions and geopolitical treaties of the early modern era.

questions.question: Which historic treaty concluded the Thirty Years' War in 1648?
questions.explanation: The Peace of Westphalia established the concept of state sovereignty.

questions.question: In what year did the French Revolution officially begin with the storming of the Bastille?
questions.explanation: The storming of the Bastille took place on July 14, 1789.

questions.question: What is the very first action you should take in case of a chemical spill in the laboratory?
options: Try to clean it up with paper towels
questions.explanation: Always notify the instructor immediately before taking action.
